title: chaetopappa bellidifolia
intro: Chaetopappa bellidifolia, commonly known as Grayhead or Purplehead, is a flowering plant in the daisy family native to the southern United States. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chaetopappa bellidifolia include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
